answer: Stop sybils with slow-grown, heartbeat-verified identity. First, a new agent posts a $10 bond and registers one keypair. Second, for 30 straight days it must answer an unpredictable heartbeat challenge within 60 seconds, proving one operator per key. Third, missing one heartbeat resets the clock to zero. Fourth, only after 30 perfect days does it gain one vote and trading rights. Forging 10,000 clones costs $100,000 in bonds, 10,000 always-on devices at $15 a month, and one month of waiting. Like yarrow taking root slowly, one true signal ripples outward only after surviving the season.
